{{Quote|Get on board the ''Falcon'', kid &ndash; this place is gonna blow!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to a spacer|audio=vo-han-solo-2ca.flac|<ref name="SWG:EFtE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Escape From the Empire|an Imperial Space Station}}</ref>}}
[[File:SWG_intro_space_station.jpg|thumb|250px|The space station, attacked by Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]]]]
An '''Imperial space station''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] along with at least two other [[Space station/Legends|stations]] of the same kind.

==Characteristics==
One of its hangar bays held several starfighters, including three [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], two [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter|Rihkxyrk Attack Ships]], a [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]], as well as two [[AEG-77 Vigo]] transport ships and a passenger shuttle.<ref name="SWG:EFtE" />

==History==
{{Quote|I'm Han Solo, and that's Chewbacca. Look, we're short on time...reinforcements are on the way. Let's go!|Han Solo, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:EFtE" />}}
[[File:Firefight_SWG_intro.jpg|thumb|right|260px|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] fighting [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the hangar of the Imperial space station.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a small battle erupted on these distant space station. A young [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] was held captive by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] on board of the station. When smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-pilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] helped the spacer escape, Imperial starfighters opened fire on their own station. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] barely escaped the station's destruction and the pursuing Imperial ships under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] command, including two [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. The ''Falcon''{{'s}} crew shot down several [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] before they jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], heading for [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG:EFtE" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|On a distant Imperial Space Station, a smaller battle erupts over the fate of a single being's destiny, yours . . . .|''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' opening crawl|<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
The Imperial space station was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EFtE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial space station was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SWG:2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

The Imperial space station was the location where the "[[W:c:swg:New Player Tutorial|New Player Tutorial]]" of the ame started. The player's character "woke up" in the medical bay and learnt the game's basic controls. In the corridor outside the medical bay, the player then met Han Solo, Chewbacca, and the droids and is led to the hangar bay, where he can shot several stormtroopers. When the player entered the ''Millennium Falcon'', a movie sequence shows the destruction of the station and the ''Falcon<nowiki>'</nowiki>''s escape. After the movie, the player took over one of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} turrets to shoot down TIE Fighters, followed by another movie sequence showing the ship as it reached Tansarii Point Station.<ref name="SWG:EFtE" />
